name: Pin & Pan Roll (Combat, Style)
body:
You can throw a rotating rolling pin at a foe and smash another with your pan in the same attack.

Prerequisites(s): Pin & Pan Smash, Pin & Pan Style, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +11.

Benefit(s): When using Pin & Pan Style and making a ranged attack with your rolling pin, you can immediately use your free hand to grasp your battle pan’s handle two-handed. You automatically try to parry any opportunity attacks provoked with your pan without forgoing a melee attack, and gain the extra damage on a successful smash for wielding a weapon two-handed.
